source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #2; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 15 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; points to NVIDIA PCIe/GPU qualification tooling but offers link/device snapshots rather than quantitative BER evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for pattern, bit population/duration, counter semantics, BER threshold/confidence, topology, control scope and recovery.

old_problem: Link presence and an empty error grep do not measure BER: they provide neither raw bit-error count nor tested-bit denominator. Counter source/reset/wrap semantics, lane mapping, stimulus and authorized limit were absent, and clearing logs would erase evidence.
disposition_reason: BER has a standard measurable form—errors divided by observed bits—but the project must bind vendor counters, denominator, pattern/load, lane scope, iterations and acceptance/confidence. These are explicit runtime configuration; the review can be complete while PASS remains impossible until a signed threshold exists. Baseline logs/counters must be preserved, not blindly cleared.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2124, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2125 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00043-V002 / 0a39fa2872b9b06b was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The defining output is quantitative per-lane or approved aggregate BER from immutable raw errors and tested-bit population; lspci/nvidia-smi health is supporting evidence only.
Bind the pinned NVQual BER recipe, HGX root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/lane map, generation/width, stimulus pattern/load and observation bit count or rate-duration basis.

Record raw counter identity, start/end values, reset/wrap behavior, timestamps, observed-bit calculation, BER formula, threshold and confidence rule; zero errors only support a bound, not an unqualified zero-BER claim.
Preserve/hash existing logs and counter provenance rather than erasing them. Any controlled vendor counter reset must be explicitly defined and must not delete platform evidence.
No PASS is permitted without signed per-lane/aggregate threshold and confidence; missing threshold yields runtime BLOCKED, not an invented oracle.

Do not infer or add reset/power actions; if the pinned manifest contains one, separately authorize exact semantics and stop on limit breach, counter anomaly, downtrain, device loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or evidence gap.
No NVQual/BER stimulus, counter reset/read, PCIe query, reset, power cycle, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Counter- and denominator-traceable HGX NVQual PCIe BER qualification
test_case.purpose: Measure PCIe BER on the approved HGX path/lane set under the pinned NVQual stimulus and compare traceable raw errors over a defined bit population with the signed project limit while preserving link/device/host stability.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual BER package, license, manifest/configuration and compatible firmware/driver
Signed HGX root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane topology and target generation/width
Approved pattern/load, observation bits or rate-duration basis, counter sources/reset/wrap semantics and formula
Signed per-lane/aggregate BER threshold, confidence, iterations and permitted control boundaries
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, immutable evidence store, console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and BER threshold are signed. Export/hash baseline logs and raw counters. After point approval run only the pinned NVQual BER pattern and observation population; preserve per-lane counter start/end, tested bits or rate-duration basis, formula, calculated BER, threshold/confidence comparison, link state and health for each iteration. Stop on first limit, counter, link/device or evidence anomaly; do not clear, extend or retry.
test_case.expected_result: For every approved lane/iteration, immutable counter deltas and tested-bit denominator produce a BER satisfying the signed per-lane/aggregate limit and confidence rule; required link generation/width and NVIDIA inventory remain intact with no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without approved counter semantics, denominator, formula, threshold and confidence. PASS then requires every lane/iteration to meet the signed BER limit with complete stability evidence. FAIL on limit breach, counter discontinuity/wrap ambiguity, downtrain/device loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing configuration, threshold or artifact is BLOCKED; retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until recipe, lane map, bit population/counters, BER threshold/confidence, iteration/control scope and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline platform evidence; do not claim zero BER from a zero-error snapshot or unknown denominator.
Any reset/power action needs independent exact authorization and is otherwise prohibited.
Stop without duration extension, counter manipulation or retry at first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved BER manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver identities and complete target path/per-lane map
Pattern/load, generation/width, raw counter source/reset/wrap, observed-bit basis, formula, threshold/confidence and iteration contract
Per-iteration/per-lane immutable start/end errors, observed bits, calculated BER, threshold result and timestamps
Full link/NVIDIA inventory plus AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power stability artifacts and photos as support
First-fault/recovery or clean final link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On BER breach, counter anomaly/discontinuity, downtrain, device loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit all later stimulus and preserve the first event. Do not reset counters or rerun before evidence is secured; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items supply BER identity and Procedure supplies the NVQual family; generic Criteria is under-specified but not contradictory.

blocked.reason: The review-layer measurement method is complete. Runtime remains BLOCKED until project counter semantics and an authoritative threshold/confidence are bound.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Pinned NVQual BER recipe, path/lane map, pattern/load, bit population or duration/data-rate, raw counter semantics, formula, signed threshold/confidence, iterations/control scope and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED QUANTITATIVE BER GATE CLOSED; NO NVQUAL/BER STIMULUS, COUNTER RESET/READ, PCIE QUERY, RESET, POWER CYCLE, LOG CLEAR, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: HGX/NVIDIA qualification, PCIe signal-integrity and project specification owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind all project inputs including an authoritative BER threshold/confidence and receive point authorization; without them execution remains BLOCKED and cannot PASS.

external_authorities.application: Requires command-purpose fit, quantitative evidence and approved threshold; allows parameterization but forbids log destruction, invented controls and automatic retry.

project_authority: NVIDIA/PCIe SI owner supplies BER recipe/counter oracle; project owner signs threshold/confidence; platform owner maps path and recovery; engineer owns verdict.
